model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the overall performance (in percent) for a set of language models within the EBS-AOS pattern, shown as a single series of vertical bars with numeric values annotated above each bar. The categories are arranged along the horizontal axis as an unlabeled sequence of individual models (category names are not visible in the provided image), with evenly spaced bars and no apparent grouping separators or legend. The vertical axis is the value axis and is labeled “Overall Performance (%)”; it uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are 12 bars, each in a distinct muted color (e.g., teal, purple, blue, mauve, light blue-gray, tan, pale blue, lavender, beige, light gray, off-white, and light pink), and each bar has its exact value printed on top: approximately 76.24, 73.94, 34.24, 72.09, 77.12, 46.02, 76.71, 67.58, 63.63, 66.50, 64.34, and 67.55. The smallest bar is the third (about 34.24%), and the tallest bar is the fifth (about 77.12%), with most other bars falling between roughly the low 60s and high 70s. The bars do not appear to be sorted by height or alphabetically based on the visible ordering, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the uniform presence of value labels above each bar.
